# The paths a pull request may change without a `Review:` line for its head (the rule is in this
# repository's CLAUDE.md): what
# programista-prosty may change (.claude/agents/programista-prosty.md, "You may change"),
# narrowed where its list is a judgement. Every other path is on the risk list, so a new
# folder starts there. Not here: config/locales/ (the agent may change a value, never a
# key, and a path cannot tell them apart), the test data under spec/ (the specs prove the
# plugin with it, and the gateway's vector lies among it), and mechanical refactors (a
# refactor is told by its diff, not by its path). CI reads this list from the pull
# request's base.
#
# One pattern a line: `dir/` matches everything below dir, `**/name` a file of that name in
# any folder, anything else one exact path. A `!` line is a risk path inside an exempt one
# and wins over it. spec/repo/review_trail_spec.rb pins the risk markers of
# spec/repo/claude_rules_spec.rb against this list.
README.md
docs/
!**/CLAUDE.md
